title: Benchmarking the Quantum Leap: Auditing LLM Evaluation for Quantum Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28678v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate quantum programs, but reliable evaluation remains difficult because benchmarks differ in task composition, scoring, and failure handling. We evaluate 15 hosted frontier, open-weight, quantum-specialized, and retrieval-augmented models on five quantum code-generation suites (530 tasks), plus 10 models on our new QuantumBenchEval (QBE) benchmark (96 tasks across six topics). We report bootstrap confidence intervals, multiplicity-adjusted paired comparisons, and audits of output validity and evaluator behavior. QiskitHumanEval-Standard approaches saturation (98.7% pass@1), while its Hard variant retains headroom (63.8%). None of the five top-two comparisons across primary suites remains significant after multiple-comparison correction. Evaluator design substantially changes scores: removing checks for unspecified quantities raises GPT-6 Astra's QBE pass@1 from 0% to 94.1% (T1) and from 1.2% to 92.9%

translated_title: 量子跃迁的基准测试：审计大语言模型量子代码生成的评估方法
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够生成量子程序，但由于各基准测试在任务构成、评分方式和失败处理上存在差异，可靠的评估仍然困难。我们在五个量子代码生成测试套件（共530个任务）上评估了15个托管的前沿模型、开放权重模型、量子专用模型和检索增强模型，并在我们新提出的QuantumBenchEval（QBE）基准（涵盖六个主题的96个任务）上评估了10个模型。我们报告了bootstrap置信区间、经过多重比较校正的配对比较，以及对输出有效性和评估器行为的审计。结果显示QiskitHumanEval-Standard已接近饱和（98.7% pass@1），而其Hard变体仍保留提升空间（63.8%）。经过多重比较校正后，主要测试套件中五项前二名模型的配对比较均不再显著。评估器的设计会显著改变分数：移除对未指定量的检查后，GPT-6 Astra在QBE上的pass@1从0%提升至94.1%（T1），从1.2%提升至92.9%
tldr: 该研究系统性地基准测试了15个大型语言模型在量子代码生成任务上的表现，并首次揭示评估器的设计差异会极大扭曲评分结果——仅移除对未指定量的检查即可使模型pass@1从0%跃升至94.1%，说明量子代码生成评估亟需严格的审计与标准化。
en_tdlr: This study systematically benchmarks 15 LLMs on quantum code generation tasks and reveals that evaluator design dramatically distorts scores—simply removing checks for unspecified quantities raises a model's pass@1 from 0% to 94.1%—highlighting the urgent need for rigorous auditing and standardization of quantum code evaluation.
